title: Etale exceptional locality over arbitrary schemes
statement: Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring, $U,X,Y$ arbitrary schemes, $u:U\to X$ quasi-compact separated etale, $f:X\to Y$, and $h:U\to Y$ with $h=fu$ [def-weil-etale-morphism, def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Suppose $f,h$ admit compactifications [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. On ordinary unbounded derived categories of constant-A etale module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], the chosen exceptional inverse images [thm-amb-etale-exceptional-adjoint] satisfy a natural isomorphism $u^*Rf^!\cong Rh^!$. There are no Noetherian or quasi-compactness assumptions on f or h.

source.place: Second paragraph, displayed Hom calculation and Yoneda; generality of the existing source-library theorem

proof.text: Substitute h=uf. Choose a compactification U -> Z -> Y of h. The graph a:U -> Z times_Y X has first projection the open immersion into Z, hence a is an immersion. The second projection is proper by base change. Quasi-compactness of u and the immersion-into-proper construction give a compactification of u. No quasi-compactness of h or f is used.

The generalized graph comparison identifies the chosen unbounded Ru_! with degreewise exact etale sum extension. Transport the exact derived sum-extension/inverse-image adjunction along this isomorphism, obtaining Ru_! left adjoint to D(u^*).

Compose this adjunction with Rf_! left adjoint to Rf^!. The existing unbounded compact-support composition isomorphism identifies its left adjoint with Rh_!. Thus Rf^! followed by D(u^*) and Rh^! are right adjoints to the same functor. Mathlib Adjunction.rightAdjointUniq gives their natural isomorphism. Finally use the exact-functor comparison Lu^* congruent to D(u^*).

proof_origin.place: Hom calculation and Yoneda, implemented by composition of adjunctions and rightAdjointUniq

from.place: Ambient adjoint locality, source-library generality without Noetherian hypotheses
